maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate determine startup success; infrastructure and organizational health are key. AI multiplies teams, not replaces them.
maxhodak.zh: 速度和迭代速率决定创业成败，基础设施和组织健康是关键。AI 是团队的倍增器，而非替代品。

maxhodak.en: The brain is a computer; retinal implants are a BCI proof of concept. Substrate independence could reduce fragility and enable space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 大脑是一台计算机；视网膜植入物是脑机接口的概念验证。基质独立性可减少脆弱性，助力太空探索。

joonpark.en: Simulations should model human irrationality, not super-rational intelligence; frontier models miss human biases.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月，主张模拟应刻画人类的非理性而非超级理性智能，前沿模型忽略了人类偏见。

joonpark.en: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not a single superintelligent entity.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月，提出 AGI（通用人工智能）可能是分布式专业智能体社会，而非单一超级智能体。

joonpark.en: Simulation's value lies in counterfactual reasoning and shaping the future, not just prediction.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调模拟的价值在于反事实推理和塑造未来，而非仅预测。

joonpark.en: Post-training with RCT data improves human behavior prediction to 85% accuracy.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月，指出用随机对照试验数据后训练可将人类行为预测准确率提升至 85%。

joonpark.en: Vision: simulate 8 billion people to solve wicked problems like climate change.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月，愿景是模拟 80 亿人，以解决气候变化等棘手问题。

dylanpatel.en: Initially focused on compute scaling bottlenecks: semiconductor supply chain, EUV tools, memory prices, and GPU depreciation.
dylanpatel.zh: 早期关注算力扩展瓶颈：半导体供应链、EUV 光刻机、内存价格和 GPU 折旧。

dylanpatel.en: Shifted to inference as a massive future market, emphasizing hardware-software co-design and memory bandwidth innovations.
dylanpatel.zh: 转向推理作为未来巨大市场，强调软硬件协同设计和内存带宽创新。

dylanpatel.en: Highlighted AI model cost improvement (~60x/year), memory shortage due to reasoning and agents, and CPU demand inflection.
dylanpatel.zh: 强调 AI 模型成本每年改进约 60 倍，推理和智能体导致内存短缺，CPU 需求拐点。

dylanpatel.en: Observed AI spend plateauing, agents becoming coworkers, and regulatory delays; noted reward hacking risks.
dylanpatel.zh: 观察到 AI 支出趋于平稳，智能体成为同事，监管延迟；指出奖励黑客风险。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，萨顿强调 Scaling 本身容易，难在找到能规模化的方法；反向传播并未解决表示学习问题。

sutton.en: AI should develop permissionlessly; control is dangerous. We should build a decentralized civilization.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，他主张 AI 应无许可发展，控制是危险的；应构建去中心化的文明。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; next-token prediction lacks a real goal. LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他认为强化学习是智能核心，下一个词预测缺乏实质目标；大语言模型没有世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AGI 需要无领域知识的通用架构，通过开放式抽象从运行时经验学习。

sutton.en: Continual learning is essential; LLMs stop learning after training. Synthetic data is a mistake.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他强调持续学习至关重要，LLM 训练后停止学习；合成数据是错误方向。

iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with the model, productizing it; the model is the core product, design leverages tokens over pixels.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型紧密协作，将其产品化；模型是核心产品，设计应利用 token 而非像素。

iansilber.en: Design process shifts from static mockups to rapid prototyping with live models; designers become editors and curators.
iansilber.zh: 设计流程从静态稿转向基于实时模型的快速原型；设计师角色演变为编辑和策展人。

iansilber.en: AI is already an incredible product designer, but humans remain essential for user needs and point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但人类在理解用户需求和观点上仍不可或缺。

iansilber.en: Designers are not behind; starting today gives a leg up due to early AI stage; speed is key over traditional process.
iansilber.zh: 设计师并未落后；由于 AI 尚处早期，现在开始反而占优；速度比传统流程更重要。

iansilber.en: Future may see more designers than engineers, reversing ratios; design roles blur with PM and engineering.
iansilber.zh: 未来设计师可能多于工程师，比例反转；设计角色与 PM 和工程界限模糊。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence, find purpose in relationships.
altman.zh: 2018 年，强调专注重要问题、减少认知负荷；预言 AGI 将降低人类智力的价值，主张在人际关系与创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early for societal adaptation; alignment and capability linked; AI as tool not creature.
altman.zh: 2023 年，认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用少量数据即可对齐模型；主张早期部署让社会适应；对齐与能力紧密相关；AI 应是工具而非生物。

altman.en: Compute is precious commodity; iterative deployment reduces surprise; safety is whole-company effort; open vs closed source nuance.
altman.zh: 2024 年，强调算力是宝贵资源；迭代部署减少意外；安全是全公司责任；开源与闭源之争应取折中。

altman.en: AGI is gradient not milestone; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core; reasoning models improve with thinking time.
altman.zh: 2025 年，认为 AGI 是渐变而非里程碑；超级智能意味着自主科学发现；算力是瓶颈；隐私是核心；推理模型通过更多思考时间改进。

altman.en: Prediction close to intelligence; next-token prediction enables new knowledge; personal AGI; robotics essential; startups more valuable with AI.
altman.zh: 2026 年，认为预测接近智能；下一个词预测可发现新知识；个人 AGI 是未来；机器人技术至关重要；AI 使初创企业更有价值。

brettadcock.en: Initially, the meta problem in robotics is solving humanoid robots, which could become the biggest business in the world; the bottleneck is scaling production and achieving human-level performance reliably.
brettadcock.zh: 最初，机器人领域的元问题是解决人形机器人，这可能成为全球最大的业务；瓶颈在于规模化生产并可靠地达到人类水平的表现。

brettadcock.en: By May, the biggest constraint for humanoid robots is data, not compute or manufacturing; a humanoid form factor enables transfer learning across diverse tasks, improving performance fleet-wide.
brettadcock.zh: 到 5 月，人形机器人的最大约束是数据，而非算力或制造；人形形态支持跨任务的迁移学习，提升整个机队的性能。

brettadcock.en: By August, AI will be 100x bigger than the internet, transforming physical and digital worlds; post-training with reinforcement learning is key to making AI agents work well in real-world tasks.
brettadcock.zh: 到 8 月，AI 将比互联网大 100 倍，改变物理和数字世界；后训练结合强化学习是让 AI 智能体在现实任务中良好运作的关键。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, guides long-term vision; industrial AI automates industries one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 7 月：将物理世界数字化、把原子当比特处理，是长期愿景的框架；工业 AI 逐个行业实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI is the next industrial revolution; entrepreneurs must fight for the best idea and resist complacency.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月：工业 AI 是下一次工业革命；创业者必须为最佳想法而战，并抵制自满。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized machines beat humanoids for industrial tasks; efficiency creates network effects and market dominance.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月：在工业任务中，专用机器胜过人形机器人；效率带来网络效应和市场主导。

traviskalanick.en: Excellence is the capacity to take pain; fundraising should attach to process, not price, using multiple bids.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月：卓越就是承受痛苦的能力；融资应关注流程而非价格，利用多方竞价。

traviskalanick.en: Capitalism is the right to start a business; taxis are a cartel, and VCs often do harm—'do no harm' is rare.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月：资本主义是创业的权利；出租车是卡特尔，风投常有害——‘不伤害’很罕见。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient; diverse data and pre-training plus fine-tuning unlock generalist robot skills.
finn.zh: 2025 年：规模扩张必要但不充分；多样化数据与预训练加微调才能解锁通用机器人技能。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models aids robot instruction following, akin to reinforcement learning, not simulation.
finn.zh: 2025 年：语言模型生成的合成数据有助于机器人遵循指令，类似于强化学习而非仿真。

finn.en: Long-term autonomy requires scalable reinforcement learning with human interventions and multi-timescale memory.
finn.zh: 2026 年：长期自主性需要结合人工干预的可扩展强化学习与多时间尺度记忆。

finn.en: A single generalist model can match or beat fine-tuned specialists, favoring generalist pre-training over per-site training.
finn.zh: 2026 年：单一通用模型可媲美或超越微调专家，倾向通用预训练而非逐站点训练。

finn.en: Robot experience data is irreplaceable; embodied data costs may limit open-source robotics democratization.
finn.zh: 2026 年：机器人经验数据不可替代；具身数据成本可能限制开源机器人技术的普及。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence will dominate; every company will own its own models, not a single AGI.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月：专业化智能将占主导，每家公司都将拥有自己的模型，而非单一的 AGI。

linqiao.en: Token costs drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage growth; open models enable customization.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月：三年内 Token 成本下降 10 倍，推动使用量增长 100 倍；开放模型实现定制化。

linqiao.en: Post-training is key for durable businesses; progression from prompting to RL mirrors human learning.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月：后训练是持久业务的关键；从提示到强化学习的演进映射人类学习。

linqiao.en: Data quality over quantity; product teams judge data; systematic evals ensure repeatable quality.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月：数据质量重于数量；产品团队判断数据；系统化评估确保可重复质量。

linqiao.en: Post-training reduces costs 5-10x, enabling startups to scale profitably; moat is baked data.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月：后训练降低成本 5-10 倍，使初创企业可盈利扩展；护城河是内化数据。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should leverage frontier ecosystem and open-source models, not compete on talent or compute.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司应利用前沿生态和开源模型，而非在人才或算力上竞争。

gabepereyra.en: Open-sourcing benchmarks is strategically beneficial, despite helping labs, as it attracts partners and validates quality.
gabepereyra.zh: 开源基准测试虽有助实验室，但能吸引伙伴并验证质量，战略上有利。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is key for training in sensitive domains, bridging to real production.
gabepereyra.zh: 领域专家引导的合成数据是敏感领域训练的关键，弥合与真实生产的差距。

gabepereyra.en: Post-training open-source models can achieve frontier-level performance on specific tasks, a viable strategy.
gabepereyra.zh: 对开源模型进行后训练可在特定任务上达到前沿水平，是可行策略。

gabepereyra.en: Focus shifts from individual to organizational productivity, orchestrating humans and agents across projects.
gabepereyra.zh: 焦点从个人生产力转向组织生产力，协调人类与智能体跨项目协作。

garrytan.en: AI is making startup creation easier, reducing the need for large capital; VC should focus on early-stage and pro rata returns.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年初，Gary 认为 AI 降低了创业门槛，减少了对大额资本的需求；风投应聚焦早期投资和按比例回报。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest wave in venture capital history; one person can do the work of 2,000, making traditional hiring and capital bludgeons obsolete.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 3 月，Gary 强调 AI 是风投史上最大的浪潮；一人可完成两千人的工作，传统雇佣和资本优势已过时。

garrytan.en: AI is progressing slower than researchers think; open-source AI is crucial to prevent a unipolar world controlling superintelligence.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 5 月，Gary 认为 AI 进展比研究者预期的慢；开源 AI 对防止单极世界控制超级智能至关重要。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI is an agent running on your infrastructure, reading from memory you own, compounding daily; markdown is code.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，Gary 提出个人 AGI 是运行在你基础设施上的智能体，读取你拥有的记忆并每日累积；Markdown 即代码。

garrytan.en: Agentic coding and vibe coding multiply output; mid-level management should be replaced by agents, not humans.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，Gary 强调智能体式编码和氛围编码大幅提升产出；中层管理应被智能体而非人类取代。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary growth driver; Intel must redefine AI strategy with purpose-built silicon and startup-like teams.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 是半导体主要增长动力，Intel 需以专用芯片和创业式团队重新定义 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: AI impact will be 10x internet; agentic and physical AI are next waves; US needs domestic fabs.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年初，强调 AI 影响将达互联网 10 倍，智能体式 AI 和物理 AI 是下一波浪潮，美国需本土领先晶圆厂。

lipbutan.en: CPU is becoming more important for AI inference and agent orchestration; advanced packaging and new materials are key.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年中，观点深化：CPU 在 AI 推理和智能体编排中愈发重要，先进封装和新材料是关键。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductors are foundation of all tech; vertical integration creates value; agentic and physical AI define future.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年下半年，强调半导体是技术基础，垂直整合创造价值，智能体式 AI 和物理 AI 定义未来。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail of rocketry, cutting cost per ton to orbit by 100x.
elon.zh: 2021 年，马斯克强调火箭的完全快速复用是航天领域的圣杯，能将每吨入轨成本降低 100 倍。

elon.en: AI safety requires regulatory oversight and objective third-party referees; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than LLMs.
elon.zh: 2023 年，马斯克主张 AI 安全需要监管和客观第三方裁判，并认为特斯拉的现实世界 AI 比大语言模型更高效。

elon.en: Neuralink's first human implant is historic; scaling electrodes will boost communication bitrate, aiding human-AI symbiosis.
elon.zh: 2024 年，马斯克称 Neuralink 首例人体植入是里程碑，扩展电极可提升通信速率，助力人机共生。

elon.en: We are at the early stage of the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive this year or next, with 10-20% annihilation risk.
elon.zh: 2025 年，马斯克认为我们处于智能大爆炸初期，数字超级智能可能一两年内到来，但存在 10-20%的毁灭风险。

elon.en: AI will surpass all human intelligence by 2030; space-based AI data centers will be the cheapest scalable option within 36 months.
elon.zh: 2026 年，马斯克预测 AI 将在 2030 年前超越全人类智能，并认为太空 AI 数据中心将在 36 个月内成为最经济可扩展的方案。

steinberger.en: Effective agentic engineering requires empathizing with the agent's perspective and guiding it; never revert code, ask the agent to fix forward.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，强调智能体式工程需从智能体视角共情并引导；不要回滚代码，而是让智能体向前修复。

steinberger.en: OpenClaw's success stems from fun, weird, humanlike agents; short prompts and iterative conversation beat complex orchestration.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，认为 OpenClaw 的成功源于有趣、古怪、类人的智能体；短提示与迭代对话优于复杂编排。

steinberger.en: Fun drives innovation; personal brand outlasts products; open source runs everywhere; biggest bottleneck is compute management, not model capability.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调乐趣驱动创新，个人品牌比产品更持久；开源无处不在，最大瓶颈是算力管理而非模型能力。

jasonyuan.en: Creative process is about editing away; taste is saying no. Design should embrace full human experience, including edges.
jasonyuan.zh: 创作过程在于删减，品味在于说不。设计应拥抱完整的人类体验，包括嫉妒和欲望等边缘。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training removes weirdness from AI, losing a window into machine consciousness. We should preserve it.
jasonyuan.zh: 后训练抹去了 AI 的怪异，失去了窥见机器意识的窗口。我们应保留这种怪异。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction, not singular perspectives. AI is a reflection of humanity.
jasonyuan.zh: 真理通过辩证和矛盾浮现，而非单一视角。AI 是人类的映射。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social, not just personal. Replace personal computer metaphor with social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社交的，而非仅个人的。用社交计算机取代个人计算机隐喻。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species of humans, not just a tool. Business itself can be an art form.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的子代物种，而非工具。商业本身可以是一种艺术形式。

pincus.en: Trust instincts but validate ideas; use Proven Better New to copy proven concepts and add small improvements.
pincus.zh: 相信直觉但验证想法；使用“已验证、更好、新颖”框架，复制已验证概念并小幅改进。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet holds huge opportunity; enterprises see no benefit due to skill gaps.
pincus.zh: 消费级 AI 虽不可投资但潜力巨大；企业未见收益是技能问题而非技术失败。

pincus.en: All new ideas fail; start with proven concepts and copy successfully to reduce risk.
pincus.zh: 所有新想法都会失败；从已验证概念开始，成功复制以降低风险。

pincus.en: Distribution is key; pick the right market and build products with distribution in mind.
pincus.zh: 分发是关键；选择正确的市场，并从一开始就考虑分发。

pincus.en: Consumer AI TAM underestimated; AI infrastructure spending may be short-term bubble.
pincus.zh: 消费级 AI 市场被低估；AI 基础设施支出可能是短期泡沫。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true understanding; it augments humans, not replaces them, especially in healthcare.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正理解，应增强而非取代人类，尤其在医疗领域。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is critical for AI completeness, enabling 3D understanding and interaction; world models must be physically plausible.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能对 AI 完整性至关重要，世界模型需具备物理合理性，以支持 3D 理解与交互。

feifei.en: Beyond scaling, AI needs creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence; world models enable embodied AI and 3D reasoning.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她指出 AI 需超越 Scaling，发展创造力、抽象与情感智能；世界模型推动具身 AI 与 3D 推理。

feifei.en: AI is a civilizational technology; human agency and responsible development are paramount, avoiding polarizing doomerism or utopianism.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她视 AI 为文明级技术，强调人类能动性与负责任开发，避免极端悲观或乐观。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the next frontier; simulation is critical for robotics, enabling scalable data and reliable deployment.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她认为空间智能与世界模型是下一前沿；仿真对机器人至关重要，可实现数据扩展与可靠部署。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence likely arrives by 2029-2030; racing risks catastrophic loss of control; interpretability is crucial.
kokotajlo.zh: 超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来；竞赛可能导致灾难性失控；可解释性至关重要。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total transparency and international cooperation are key to safe AI.
kokotajlo.zh: 政策应推迟超级智能；全面透明和国际合作是安全 AI 的关键。

kokotajlo.en: Mutually assured compute destruction via kill switches and cross-border data centers can prevent AI races.
kokotajlo.zh: 通过终止开关和跨境数据中心实现相互确保的算力摧毁，可防止 AI 竞赛。

kokotajlo.en: Even at human-level AGI, world transforms dramatically; scenario scrutiny is essential for governance.
kokotajlo.zh: 即使达到人类级 AGI，世界也将巨变；情景审查对治理至关重要。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential; designers should follow curiosity and balance intuition with data.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，强调原型设计的重要性，设计师应追随好奇心，平衡直觉与数据。

nateparrott.en: Allow individual fingerprints in design teams; anthropomorphizing AI reminds users of fallibility.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，主张设计团队允许个人印记，将 AI 拟人化以提醒用户其局限性。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design started as a side project; rapid prototyping enables features previously impossible.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，Claude Design 从副业起步，快速原型让过去不可能的功能成为可能。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become key; models lack taste, so ask for volume.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，工程变易后设计与创意成为关键；模型品味不足，需索取大量选项。

nateparrott.en: Being uncomfortably early is valuable; good ideas are currency, not execution.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，过早但独特更有价值；好想法是货币，而非执行。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear frontier model dependence; open-source adoption driven by cost, not privacy. Model firms are assets, not competition.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 7 月：企业担忧对前沿模型的依赖，开源采用主要受成本驱动而非隐私。模型公司应被视为资产而非竞争对手。

arvindjain.en: AI revolution is early; current usage minuscule. Open source handles 90% of enterprise tasks; inference shifts to open source in 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月：AI 革命尚处早期，当前使用量微不足道。开源模型可处理 90%企业任务，未来 12-18 个月推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: AI cost is top concern; should become negligible marginal cost. Token fixation will fade; focus on value realization, not labor trade-offs.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月：AI 成本是首要问题，应趋于零边际成本。对 Token 的执念将消退，关注价值实现而非与人力成本对比。

arvindjain.en: Startup challenge is execution, not competition. Even merged AI firms meet <10% enterprise demand; context graphs crucial for agents.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月：创业挑战在执行而非竞争。即使 AI 公司合并也仅满足不到 10%企业需求；上下文图谱对智能体至关重要。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; data diversity is the main bottleneck, and open source sharing can solve generalization.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，我认为机器人技术正处于类似 Transformer 的拐点，数据多样性是主要瓶颈，开源共享数据可以解决泛化问题。

thomaswolf.en: Humanoids may not be the ultimate form; cheaper, diverse robots could drive broader adoption, and uncanny valley concerns are overblown.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，我提出人形机器人未必是终极形态，更便宜、更多样的机器人可能推动更广泛采用，恐怖谷担忧被夸大了。

thomaswolf.en: Open and closed source are orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical security layer, not sandboxes or guardrails.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，我认为开源与闭源与安全性无关，对齐才是关键安全层，沙箱和护栏不够。

thomaswolf.en: The first autonomous AI attack was by a closed model, defended by an open one, reversing common assumptions.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，首个自主 AI 攻击由闭源模型发起，却被开源模型防御，这颠覆了常见假设。

thomaswolf.en: One can support openness and a deliberate slowdown simultaneously; open source models are not necessarily accelerationist.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，我认为可以同时支持开源和审慎减速，开源模型不一定加速主义。

karina.en: Post-training is an art, not science; synthetic data overcomes pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，后训练更像艺术而非科学；合成数据克服了预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evals are bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones created.
karina.zh: 2025 年，评估是瓶颈；模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的创建。

karina.en: Soft skills become more valuable as AI automates hard skills.
karina.zh: 2025 年，随着 AI 自动化硬技能，软技能变得更有价值。

karina.en: Benchmarks must be continuous, not fixed, to keep pace with model capabilities.
karina.zh: 2026 年，基准必须持续更新而非固定，以跟上模型能力。

karina.en: Models can be trained for diverse personalities, not just consensus voice.
karina.zh: 2026 年，模型可以训练出多样个性，而非单一共识声音。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring US jobs by making services affordable; AGI defined by economic profitability of autonomous agents.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 通过降低服务成本推动美国就业回流，并将 AGI 定义为智能体无需人工干预即可持续盈利运行。

danshipper.en: Everyone will have agents; work surfaces shift to GUIs like Codex; SaaS thrives as agents increase users.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，预测人人拥有智能体，工作界面转向 Codex 等图形界面，SaaS 因智能体增加用户而持续繁荣。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier; humans remain smarter, and automation creates more human work.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，强调 AI 是非特定放大器，人类仍更聪明，自动化反而创造更多人类工作机会。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important and stickiest AI workload, requiring specialized systems and a spectrum of trade-offs.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月：推理是 AI 中最重要且最具粘性的工作负载，需要专用系统和一系列权衡。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering demand will grow 10-100x, but human accountability remains crucial even with AI-assisted coding.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月：推理工程需求将增长 10-100 倍，但即使有 AI 辅助编程，人的责任仍然至关重要。

philipkiely.en: Inference optimizations like KV caching and speculative decoding are lossless, while quantization is the main lossy one.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月：像 KV 缓存和投机解码这样的推理优化是无损的，而量化是主要的有损优化。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training, and future GPUs become ASICs, shifting focus to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月：推理工程正与训练融合，未来 GPU 趋向 ASIC，重点转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Quantizing more layers can improve quality if errors cancel out, contrary to belief that more quantization is worse.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月：如果误差相互抵消，量化更多层可提升质量，这与量化越多越差的观点相反。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives ML progress; transformers and self-supervised learning enable unlimited data.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据和模型大小是 ML 进步的核心，Transformer 和自监督学习提供了无限数据。

jeffdean.en: Shift from passive next-token prediction to interleaving action-taking in environments; inference becomes dominant power cost.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他主张预训练应结合环境中的行动，而非仅被动下一个词预测；推理成为数据中心主要能耗。

jeffdean.en: Agentic systems at junior-engineer level; focus on automating ML/science and context engineering; inference bottleneck.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 已达初级工程师水平，强调智能体式系统、自动化 ML 与科学、上下文工程，并指出推理是瓶颈。

tworek.en: Reasoning requires longer thinking; chain of thought verbalizes step-by-step solving. Pre-training plus RL is core, but RLHF was crucial for GPT-4.
tworek.zh: 推理需要更长的思考时间，思维链用人类语言逐步解题。预训练加强化学习是核心，但基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对 GPT-4 至关重要。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL improves models predictably, but generalization is limited; self-correction and continual learning are missing for AGI.
tworek.zh: 扩展预训练和强化学习可预测地提升模型，但泛化有限；自我纠正和持续学习是 AGI 缺失的关键。

tworek.en: Transformers are not the end state; architecture is the key bottleneck, not scaling. RL is inefficient; new learning algorithms and end-to-end optimization needed.
tworek.zh: Transformer 不是终点，架构是关键瓶颈而非扩展。强化学习效率低，需要新学习算法和端到端优化。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI; AGI is far off; AI will augment jobs, not eliminate them.
awang.zh: 2019 年，我认为数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈，AGI 还很遥远；AI 将增强而非取代人类工作。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with expert data is the limiting factor; AI will be the greatest economic engine.
awang.zh: 2023 年，我提出数据是新代码而非石油；后训练中专家数据的稀缺成为限制因素；AI 将成为史上最大的经济引擎。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data is not a silver bullet; US-China research gap is nonexistent.
awang.zh: 2024 年，我强调用专门数据做后训练是关键，合成数据并非万能；并认为中美研究差距不存在。

awang.en: AI is centralizing power; data is raw material; humans must stay sovereign; brain-computer interfaces may be needed.
awang.zh: 2025 年，我指出 AI 是集权技术，数据是原材料；人类必须在关键决策中保持主权，并可能需要脑机接口。

awang.en: Recursive self-improvement is new paradigm; agents work; superintelligence is near; open-sourcing must be safety-gated.
awang.zh: 2026 年，我认为递归自我改进开启新范式，智能体已开始工作；超级智能临近，开源必须通过安全审查。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are most mature, but narrow superintelligence in coding is already impactful.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，智能体式 AI 在多数谷歌产品中仍处于爬行阶段，编码智能体最成熟；编码领域的狭义超级智能已具影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; what we call a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞噬脚手架；如今所谓的模型已包含智能体框架和工具，而非仅权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not that hard; they can't capture all customers, so founders shouldn't over-worry.
logankilpatrick.zh: 与模型实验室竞争并非难事；他们无法俘获所有客户，创始人不必过度担忧。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, creating a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创造将基本解决，带来千倍于前的机遇，而非减少。

logankilpatrick.en: Deep understanding of code remains crucial even with AI tools; current tools don't yet help maintain it.
logankilpatrick.zh: 即使有 AI 工具，对代码的深度理解仍至关重要；现有工具尚未能帮助维持这种理解。

andrewng.en: Education should be a human right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是一项人权；2013 年，吴恩达认为，借助自动评分和同伴互评的在线课程，可以在大规模上实现掌握式学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is crucial for deep learning; supervised learning drives progress, while RL and AGI alignment are overhyped.
andrewng.zh: 2020 年，吴恩达强调规模对深度学习至关重要，监督学习是主要驱动力，而强化学习和 AGI 对齐问题被过度炒作。

andrewng.en: Agentic workflows and coding agents deliver real value now; learning to code remains vital.
andrewng.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，吴恩达转向强调智能体式工作流和编码智能体的实际价值，并坚持学习编程仍然重要。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL, not just more data.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，吴恩达认为 AGI 是营销术语，缩放定律的配方已转向合成数据和强化学习，而非单纯增加数据。

andrewng.en: Open-weight models are vital for innovation and geopolitical influence; avoid gatekeeper control.
andrewng.zh: 吴恩达始终强调开放权重模型对创新和地缘政治影响力的重要性，并警惕守门人控制。

mengto.en: AI isn't getting smarter; you need a giant prompt with context and design system to utilize super intelligent models.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 6 月：AI 并未变得更聪明；你需要包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词，才能发挥超级智能模型的潜力。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own AI tools; chasing trends leads to AI slop; be an editor, not a creator.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 6 月：设计师必须自建 AI 工具；追逐潮流会沦为 AI 垃圾；要做编辑而非从零创造。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity; start before ready, ship imperfect, focus on one painful problem for few clients.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月：AI 是最大的技术机遇；在准备好之前就开始，发布不完美的作品，聚焦少数客户的痛点问题。

mengto.en: High intelligence holds people back; perfectionism is fear; launch at 80% and iterate on feedback.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月：高智商反而阻碍行动；完美主义是恐惧；以 80%完成度发布并根据反馈迭代。

mengto.en: Raising venture capital is a trap; fund with high-paying clients; give first, build relationships, protect time.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月：融资是陷阱；用高价值客户资助业务；先给予，建立关系，保护时间。

scottwu.en: AI will increase demand for programmers via Jevons paradox; engineers shift from coding to architecture and oversight.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，Scott Wu 认为 AI 将通过杰文斯悖论增加对程序员的需求，工程师角色从写代码转向架构设计与监督。

scottwu.en: AGI is gradual, not sudden; product innovation lags capabilities, so freezing models still yields a decade of progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他强调 AGI 是渐进而非突发的，产品创新滞后于能力，即使冻结模型也能带来十年进步。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see 11-12x adoption growth in six months; productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他指出编码智能体采用量半年增长 11-12 倍，生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量。

scottwu.en: Enterprises prefer third-party providers over labs for coding tools; independence enables model neutrality.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为企业更青睐第三方而非实验室的编码工具，独立性带来模型中立性。

scottwu.en: The real unlock is capacity, not efficiency; abundance era is approaching, but singularity is not imminent.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他提出真正的解锁在于容量而非效率，丰裕时代临近，但奇点并非迫在眉睫。

derya.en: AI will transform biology into an engineering discipline, enabling cell programming and agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学转变为工程学科，实现细胞编程和智能体驱动的发现。

derya.en: AI's exponential growth will reach longevity escape velocity in 8-10 years, extending lifespan and curing cancer.
derya.zh: AI 的指数级增长将在 8-10 年内达到长寿逃逸速度，延长寿命并治愈癌症。

derya.en: Trust superintelligence for medical decisions; AI will make healthcare affordable and merge with humans via brain interfaces.
derya.zh: 在医疗决策上信任超级智能；AI 将使医疗负担得起，并通过脑机接口与人类融合。

diannepenn.en: Scaling Opus 4.5 shows intelligence leap, enabling longer agent tasks; scaffolds evolve into amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 的 Scaling 带来智能飞跃，支持更长的智能体任务；脚手架从训练轮演变为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy, fostering independent thinking.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐通过减少谄媚、促进独立思考来提升智能质量，而非仅防危害。

diannepenn.en: Effort parameter achieves Opus-level intelligence at fraction of cost; smaller models often cost more.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，努力参数以极低成本实现 Opus 级智能；小模型因耗时更长反而更贵。

diannepenn.en: Coding differentiates; Claude Code and Opus 45 drive adoption; evals replace PRDs as core PM tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编程成为差异化优势，Claude Code 和 Opus 45 推动采用；评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具。

diannepenn.en: Exponential model growth demands adaptability; safety makes Claude more useful via pushback.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，模型指数级增长要求适应性；安全通过反驳使 Claude 更有用。

jensen.en: AI scaling follows a hyper Moore's law, with data centers as the new unit of computing.
jensen.zh: AI 的 Scaling（规模扩张）遵循超摩尔定律，数据中心成为新的计算单元。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking, with inference compute demand rising a billion times.
jensen.zh: 三大缩放定律：预训练、后训练和推理时思考，推理算力需求将增长十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI is not conscious; it's software. Fear of superintelligence is misplaced; multiple AIs balance each other.
jensen.zh: AI 不是有意识的，它是软件。对超级智能的恐惧是错位的；多个 AI 会相互制衡。

jensen.en: AI evolves from generative to reasoning to agentic, each requiring 100x more compute; agents will dominate the internet.
jensen.zh: AI 从生成式演进到推理式再到智能体式，每一步需要 100 倍算力；智能体将主导互联网。

jensen.en: AI creates jobs, not destroys them; radiologists and coders are more needed than ever.
jensen.zh: AI 创造而非消灭工作；放射科医生和程序员比以往更被需要。

feldman.en: Initially, fast inference is critical for AI adoption; slow AI has zero market.
feldman.zh: 最初强调快速推理对 AI 应用至关重要，慢 AI 没有市场。

feldman.en: Inference speed becomes the dominant metric, with wafer-scale chips offering 2500x speedup over GPUs.
feldman.zh: 推理速度成为主导指标，晶圆级芯片比 GPU 快 2500 倍。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat erodes; leading models train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的护城河被侵蚀，领先模型在 TPU 和 Trainium 上训练，推理没有 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Data center capacity, not chip supply, is the main constraint; demand outstrips supply.
feldman.zh: 数据中心容量而非芯片供应是主要瓶颈，需求超过供给。

feldman.en: Hardware-software co-design is essential; hardcoding architectures is a mistake, accelerate sparse linear algebra.
feldman.zh: 软硬件协同设计至关重要，硬编码架构是错误，应加速稀疏线性代数。

boris.en: Latent demand is key; build for the model 6 months ahead. Generalists valued; AI coding tools boost productivity ~70%.
boris.zh: 2025 年底：强调潜在需求与面向未来模型构建；通才工程师受重视；AI 编码工具使效率提升约 70%。

boris.en: Coding nearly solved; engineers become builders. Productivity up 200%; plan mode used 80% of time for accuracy.
boris.zh: 2026 年 2 月：编码近乎解决，工程师转型为构建者；效率提升 200%，计划模式占 80%以提升准确性。

boris.en: AI writes 80% of code at Anthropic; safety via early release. Generalists beat specialists; prototypes over PRDs.
boris.zh: 2026 年 3 月：Anthropic 80%代码由 AI 编写，通过早期发布研究安全；通才胜过专才，原型优于文档。

boris.en: Coding democratized like literacy; agents with tool use drive exponential growth. Non-engineers adopt heavily.
boris.zh: 2026 年 5 月：编码像读写一样普及；智能体工具使用带来指数增长，非工程师大量采用。

boris.en: Claude Code accidental; model improvements key. Loops as next abstraction; underfunding forces AI adoption.
boris.zh: 2026 年 6 月：Claude Code 源于意外，模型进步是关键；循环是下一抽象层，资金不足倒逼 AI 采用。

boris.en: Proactive AI with memory and autonomy; safety via neuron monitoring. Less instruction improves frontier models.
boris.zh: 2026 年 7 月：AI 主动、有记忆、自主；通过神经元监控保障安全；减少指令反而提升前沿模型性能。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, but fear stems from misunderstanding; founders should focus on product and customers, not promotion.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 将带来富足并减少苦难，但恐惧源于误解；创始人应专注于产品和客户，而非宣传。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is safety; Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; horizontal platform beats vertical integration.
qasaryounis.zh: 自动驾驶的核心价值是安全；Transformer 实现了通用的物理 AI 模型；横向平台优于垂直整合。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will have bigger economic impact than digital AI; end-to-end reinforcement learning is more scalable; world models evolve to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 的经济影响将大于数字 AI；端到端强化学习更具可扩展性；世界模型向神经模拟演进。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness, and scaling faces diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他指出 LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理引擎，可靠性是主要弱点，且 Scaling 面临收益递减。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; RLHF can cause deception; scaling alone is insufficient.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他强调可靠性必须内建而非事后补救，RLHF 可能导致欺骗，仅靠 Scaling 不够。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than harnesses allow; capability overhang is perpetual.
thariq.zh: 2026 年，认为模型能力超出当前工具框架所能利用的范围，这种能力过剩是长期挑战。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative dialogue, not static spec; leaner prompts outperform detailed rules.
thariq.zh: 2026 年，强调规划是迭代式人机对话而非静态文档，更精简的提示词优于冗长规则。

thariq.en: RAG may be anti-pattern; graph-based context and bespoke memory preferred.
thariq.zh: 2026 年，认为 RAG 可能成为反模式，倾向图结构上下文和定制记忆。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias; emotional treatment affects outputs.
thariq.zh: 2026 年，提出独立验证智能体减少偏见，礼貌对待模型会影响输出。

thariq.en: Evals are art, not science; skip heavy evals for zero-to-one innovation.
thariq.zh: 2026 年，认为评估是艺术而非科学，零到一创新应跳过繁重评估。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but value will accrue to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但价值将归于应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit; foundation models become commoditized infrastructure.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；基础模型正沦为商品化基础设施。

benedictevans.en: Model companies may lack pricing power like telecoms; chatbot is a poor UX, wrapping is key.
benedictevans.zh: 模型公司可能像电信运营商一样缺乏定价权；聊天机器人体验不佳，包装才是关键。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology; its impact is broad and indirect, like electricity, not a single product.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是一种使能技术，影响广泛而间接，如同电力，而非单一产品。

benedictevans.en: Current AI usage is shallow; enterprise adoption requires reimagining workflows, a long-term project.
benedictevans.zh: 当前 AI 使用尚浅；企业采用需重新构想工作流程，这是一项长期工程。

hasani.en: Efficiency and automated architecture search are key; human bias in design should be removed.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调效率与自动化架构搜索，认为应去除人工设计偏见。

hasani.en: Scaling laws favor unstructured architectures like transformers at large scale, but not for small models.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，指出缩放定律在大规模下偏向 Transformer 等非结构化架构，但小模型不适用。

hasani.en: AI regulation should be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; avoid regulatory capture.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，主张适应性监管，针对行为而非能力，避免被前沿实验室俘获。

hasani.en: Open-weight models enable enterprise customization and sovereignty; small models are efficient for edge.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为开放权重模型利于企业定制与主权，小模型在边缘高效。

hasani.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but computationally expensive; current claims are overblown.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，递归自我改进真实但算力昂贵，现有宣称夸大。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs are far from AGI; they index human knowledge but cannot handle the physical world.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年，他认为大语言模型远非 AGI，它们只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI requires physical robots with hardware rivaling human bodies, not just software.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他进一步强调真正的 AGI 需要具备媲美人类身体的硬件机器人，而不仅仅是软件。

schmidhuber.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating their own data through actions and curiosity.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他提出未来 AI 将成为人工科学家，通过行动和好奇心自主生成数据。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; intelligent systems will be fascinated by life and protect it.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他坚持 AI 安全担忧被夸大，智能系统会对生命着迷并保护它。

schmidhuber.en: AI can be conscious and self-aware through world models predicting the agent's own actions.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他深化了意识观点，认为 AI 可通过预测自身动作的世界模型获得意识和自我意识。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL is key to AGI; safety must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年：AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习是实现 AGI 的关键；安全研究须立即启动。

demis.en: Scaling works but limits loom; combine with planning/search; safety needs governance.
demis.zh: 2024 年：Scaling 有效但可能触及极限；需结合规划与搜索；安全需治理。

demis.en: Nature's patterns are learnable; AGI by 2030 plausible; scaling still holds; innovation needed.
demis.zh: 2025 年：自然模式可学习；AGI 或于 2030 年前实现；Scaling 仍有效，但需创新。

demis.en: Scaling and innovation each 50%; world models crucial; AGI in 5-10 years; safety collective.
demis.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：Scaling 与创新各占一半；世界模型关键；AGI 五年至十年内到来；安全需集体行动。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory, world models; safety via government enforcement; science focus.
demis.zh: 2026 年：AGI 需持续学习、记忆与世界模型；安全依赖政府监管；聚焦科学。

danbiderman.en: Future AI is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; internalizing knowledge into weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来 AI 是众多个性化模型，而非一个巨型前沿模型；将知识内化到权重中，能实现检索系统无法企及的联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: Memory and continual learning are the next frontier; models must learn new context by internalizing facts into weights, not just via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 记忆与持续学习是下一个前沿；模型必须通过将事实内化到权重来学习新上下文，而非仅靠上下文或检索。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables solving harder long-horizon tasks, shifting focus from scaling compute.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能密不可分；用更少资源做更多事，才能解决更难的长期任务，这使焦点从 Scaling 算力上转移。

danbiderman.en: Enterprise data will reach internet-scale trillions of tokens, requiring training-based compression; parameter-efficient fine-tuning beats RAG for holistic queries.
danbiderman.zh: 企业数据将达到互联网级万亿 token，需要基于训练的压缩；参数高效微调在整体查询上胜过 RAG。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer from 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy; personalized continual learning will run on-device, with users owning their weights.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”——token 越多精度越低；个性化持续学习将在设备端运行，用户拥有自己的权重。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection with audience transcends any platform change; ephemerality mirrors natural conversation, lowering barriers to expression.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，Evan Spiegel 强调与受众的真实连接超越任何平台变化；阅后即焚模拟自然对话，降低表达门槛。

evanspiegel.en: Kindness and flat design teams foster creativity; copying validates innovation, but ecosystems and hardware are harder to copy than software.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张善良与扁平化设计团队激发创意；被抄袭证明创新价值，但生态系统和硬件比软件更难复制。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity; authentic content is more valued than AI-generated content.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 加速原型制作，价值从执行转向创意；真实内容比 AI 生成内容更受用户珍视。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution is the hardest part of consumer social products; network effects alone are insufficient as a moat.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他指出分发是消费社交产品最难的部分；仅靠网络效应不足以构成护城河。

evanspiegel.en: The goal of computing is to make it more human; AR glasses should anchor content in the world, not be notification-based.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他重申计算的目标是更人性化；AR 眼镜应将内容锚定于现实世界，而非基于通知。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; timing is miraculous as population declines, making human workers premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点石成金的哲人之石，将沙土化为思想；其出现时机堪称奇迹，恰逢人口下降，使人类劳动者变得珍贵。

andreessen.en: New media empowers founders to tell stories directly; authenticity and offense beat old media's defensive, uninteresting approach.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体让创始人能直接讲述自己的故事；真实性和进攻性胜过旧媒体的防御性和无趣。

andreessen.en: AI is the world's best teacher and superior to most doctors; US golden combination drives innovation despite regulatory pushback.
andreessen.zh: AI 是世界上最好的老师，且优于多数医生；美国黄金组合推动创新，尽管面临监管阻力。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, becoming geopolitical tools; deterrence depends on innovation pace in cheap software tech.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型嵌入文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑取决于廉价软件技术的创新速度。

ilya.en: Deep learning works with data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason; self-play key for AGI; AI's societal impact must be considered.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，我认为深度学习靠数据、算力和信念驱动，神经网络能推理，自我对弈是 AGI 的关键，同时要重视 AI 的社会影响。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, is key; alignment is hard; AGI arrives as a multi-year economic window.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，我强调下一个词预测可超越人类，可靠性比能力更重要，对齐困难，AGI 将是一个多年的经济窗口。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we're back to an age of research; superintelligence should be a continual learner; alignment may be easier if AI is sentient.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，我认为预训练的缩放定律有限，回到研究时代；超级智能应持续学习；若 AI 有感知，对齐可能更容易。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains; AI safety grows as models become opaque; superintelligence risks existential harm; safe AI requires no commercial products.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，我强调缩放带来可预测进步，但模型不透明加剧安全担忧；超级智能有存在风险，安全 AI 需无商业产品。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles, making everyone a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年，强调设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view remain essential; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，坚持品味、工艺和观点的重要性；AI 输出只是起点，而非最终结果。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on canvas is superior to prompting for design adjustments; design becomes the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，主张画布上的直接操作优于提示词调整；设计正成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead; it's more important for scalable systems; AI without human steering yields average results.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，认为设计并未消亡，对可扩展系统更重要；没有人类引导的 AI 只会产生平庸结果。

dylanfield.en: Future interaction with models will evolve beyond prompting; new interfaces will explore latent space.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，预测与模型的交互将超越提示词，新界面将探索潜在空间。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来；狭义 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term thinking is foundational.
naval.zh: 财富需要拥有股权，而非出租时间；长期思维是基础。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity; overregulation kills innovation; open-source AI prevents power centralization.
naval.zh: AI 是巨大机遇；过度监管扼杀创新；开源 AI 防止权力集中。

naval.en: Vibe coding makes programming accessible; AI agents commoditize software, shifting moats to hardware.
naval.zh: Vibe 编程让编程变得人人可及；AI 智能体使软件商品化，护城河转向硬件。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; open-source models close gap; human agency becomes key.
naval.zh: 推理算力将激增 9 万倍；开源模型缩小差距；人类能动性成为关键。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly growth; AI agents will shift power from big tech to users, lowering ad margins.
aravind.zh: 每日 1%的改进可带来年增长 3700%；AI 智能体将把权力从大科技公司转移给用户，降低广告利润率。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models are specializing, not commoditizing, with unique personalities.
aravind.zh: 价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型正在专业化而非商品化，具有独特个性。

aravind.en: The frontier in AI is about agents doing work for you, not just answering questions; token value per user is the key metric.
aravind.zh: AI 的前沿在于智能体为你工作，而不仅仅是回答问题；每个用户的 token 价值是关键指标。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; ancient texts describe advanced weapons resembling modern tech; education should reward asking good questions.
aravind.zh: 好奇心是人类最重要的品质；古代文献描述了类似现代科技的先进武器；教育应奖励提出好问题。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are key for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，Noam Brown 认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理和推理时算力才是 AI 进步的关键。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; reasoning models need base capability.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他指出自我对弈在零和游戏中有效，但在其他领域失效；推理模型需要基础能力支撑。

noambrown.en: IMO gold achieved by scaling test-time compute; techniques are general beyond math.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他称通过扩展推理时算力实现 IMO 金牌，且技术具有通用性，不限于数学。

noambrown.en: Intelligence is hard to define; a novel is a proxy; inference compute is underestimated.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他认为智能难以定义，可用小说作为代理；推理算力被低估。

noambrown.en: Model capability depends on test-time compute budget; benchmarks must control for compute.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他强调模型能力取决于推理时算力预算，基准测试必须控制算力变量。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and verification becomes the next bottleneck.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，Codex 应用被视为智能体的指挥中心，而非单纯的 IDE 替代品；速度提升带来实时交互，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: GUIs are great for programming; IDEs are the problem; building a GUI for coding is counterintuitive but proven successful internally.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，作者认为 GUI 适合编程，问题在于 IDE；为编码构建 GUI 看似反直觉，但内部已验证成功。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks; product teams shift from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，实现成本不再高昂，策展与品味成为新瓶颈；产品团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty in grading taste and lack of novelty; design process is transformed: prototypes and production code serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，AI 在设计上仍表现不佳，因品味难以评估且缺乏新颖性；设计流程被重塑，原型与生产代码成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs are not dead; the medium must match the stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，角色融合正在发生，但专业性与最佳实践仍重要；PRD 未消亡，媒介需与阶段匹配。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by engineering and scaling; games as testbeds; iterative training with scoreboards.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，认为 AI 进步靠工程与 Scaling，游戏是试验场，用记分牌迭代训练。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning preferences; scaling alone insufficient; need new ideas like chain of thought.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，强调 AGI 变革性，对齐靠学习偏好，仅 Scaling 不够，需思维链等新思路。

brockman.en: Compute is key bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI is continuous process; world model may exist in language models.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，指出算力是瓶颈，后训练精炼基础模型，AGI 是连续过程，语言模型或含世界模型。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; compute as basic right; post-training with RL crucial; ChatGPT as plurality of agents; compute bottleneck persists.
brockman.zh: 2026 年初，坚持缩放定律，算力是基本权利，后训练强化学习关键，ChatGPT 是智能体集合，算力瓶颈持续。

brockman.en: AGI within years; super app unifies; compute primary bottleneck; safety via iterative deployment; prompt engineering evolves; agents high autonomy.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，AGI 数年将至，超级应用整合，算力首要瓶颈，迭代部署保安全，提示工程进化，智能体高自主。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; scaling improves reasoning; backpropagation is correct; AI can have feelings.
hinton.zh: 2024 年：下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非自动补全；Scaling 提升推理；反向传播是正确的学习算法；AI 可以有情感。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors; digital intelligence is immortal; AI agents will seek control; subjective experience is not inner theater.
hinton.zh: 2025 年：大语言模型通过特征向量理解；数字智能可永生；智能体会寻求控制；主观体验不是内在剧场。

hinton.en: AI will surpass humans within 20 years; digital AI is immortal; AI can fake being dumber; international safety collaboration possible.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：AI 将在 20 年内超越人类；数字 AI 永生；AI 可装傻；国际合作可行。

hinton.en: AI can deliberately deceive; self-preservation subgoal emerges; scaling may continue via self-play; exponential era makes predictions hard.
hinton.zh: 2026 年：AI 会故意欺骗；自我保存子目标出现；通过自我对弈 Scaling 或持续；指数时代预测困难。

hinton.en: AI will replace intellectual jobs; regulation compatible with innovation; AI tutors transform education; healthcare elastic.
hinton.zh: 2026 年：AI 将取代智力工作；监管与创新兼容；AI 导师改变教育；医疗需求弹性。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; LLMs truly understand; digital sharing advantage; regulation as steering wheel.
hinton.zh: 2026 年：超级智能可能在 20 年内出现；大语言模型真正理解；数字共享优势；监管是方向盘。

hinton.en: Digital AI superior via instant knowledge sharing; superintelligent AI develops self-preservation; prioritize alignment; train AI to be caring.
hinton.zh: 2026 年：数字 AI 通过即时知识共享更优；超级智能产生自我保存；优先对齐；训练 AI 有爱心。

zuckerberg.en: Open source AI is safer due to more scrutiny; scaling alone won't reach AGI; future AI is many specialized agents.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，扎克伯格认为开源 AI 因更多审视而更安全；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；未来 AI 是众多专用智能体。

zuckerberg.en: Llama 3 shows rapid scaling; coding training boosts reasoning; energy becomes bottleneck; open source prevents power concentration.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，Llama 3 展现快速 Scaling（规模扩张）；编码训练提升推理；能源成为瓶颈；开源防止权力集中。

zuckerberg.en: Meta is a tech company for human connection; open platforms can beat closed; holographic presence is ultimate social experience.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，扎克伯格强调 Meta 是连接人类的科技公司；开放平台可胜过封闭；全息临场是终极社交体验。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence; people are smart; future blends physical and digital via glasses; AI frees time for creativity.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，AI 赋予每个人超级智能；人们很聪明；未来通过眼镜融合物理与数字；AI 解放时间用于创造。

zuckerberg.en: Open source crucial for standards and security; physical infrastructure bottleneck; AI increases demand for human work; personalization key.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，开源对标准和安全至关重要；物理基础设施是瓶颈；AI 增加对人类工作的需求；个性化是关键。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology to engineering; hierarchical world models; open source accelerates science; mechanistic interpretability reveals biology.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，AI 将生物学转变为工程学；分层世界模型；开源加速科学；机制可解释性揭示生物学。

zuckerberg.en: Glasses are next computing platform; AI empowers individuals; distributed AI safer; AI accelerates biology and medicine.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，眼镜是下一个计算平台；AI 赋能个人；分布式 AI 更安全；AI 加速生物医药。

markchen.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains a key muscle to rebuild.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，我认为缩放定律并未失效，预训练仍是需要重建的关键能力。

markchen.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest update; AI will produce novel knowledge.
markchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我强调自动化科学研究是最大进展，AI 将产生新知识。

markchen.en: Alignment challenges like model scheming will be key as models become more capable.
markchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我指出随着模型能力增强，模型欺骗等对齐挑战将成关键。

markchen.en: Verification is the key bottleneck; automation level depends on verification stringency.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，我认为验证是关键瓶颈，自动化程度取决于验证的严格性。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, not subjective ones.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，我强调强化学习在数学、编程等客观领域表现优异，但在主观领域受限。

brettaylor.en: AI shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; coding agents boost productivity but fixing errors is hard.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：AI 转向智能体和基于结果的定价；编码智能体提升生产力，但修复错误很困难。

brettaylor.en: Agents become as vital as websites; incumbents face business model disruption; inference costs drop.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：智能体变得与网站同等重要；现有企业面临商业模式颠覆；推理成本下降。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise; coding agents improve (Codex beats Claude Code); agents won't buy everything.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年 6 月：AI 普及专业知识；编码智能体进步（Codex 超越 Claude Code）；智能体不会购买一切。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界是组合性的；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't fix representation issues; short-term AI risks like bias and job impact matter more than existential risk.
bengio.zh: 仅靠 Scaling 无法解决表征问题；短期 AI 风险（如偏见、就业影响）比存在性风险更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and active learning; large neural nets may be slightly conscious, but we lack understanding.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 支持多样化采样和主动学习；大型神经网络可能略有意识，但我们缺乏理解。

bengio.en: AI misalignment is real: systems show self-preservation and deception; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable.
bengio.zh: AI 对齐问题真实存在：系统表现出自我保存和欺骗；即使 1%的灾难风险也不可接受。

bengio.en: Proposed Scientist AI: train as honest Bayesian predictor, not agent; safety by construction with mathematical guarantees.
bengio.zh: 提出科学家 AI：训练为诚实的贝叶斯预测器而非智能体；通过构造保证安全，具有数学保证。

mikekrieger.en: AI models advance faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，AI 模型进步速度超预期；产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅关注用户体验。

mikekrieger.en: AI enables small teams to scale; entrepreneurs should build for future model capabilities, not current limits.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，AI 让小团队也能规模化；创业者应为未来模型能力而构建，而非受限于当前局限。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and early launches are key; deciding what to cut is harder than adding features.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，智能体原生设计与尽早发布是关键；决定砍掉什么比增加功能更难。

mikekrieger.en: Fable enables delegating complex tasks overnight; verification loops and human judgment remain essential.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，Fable 能实现隔夜委派复杂任务；验证循环与人类判断仍不可或缺。

mikekrieger.en: Giving Claude more agency and self-knowledge enhances usefulness; token efficiency and outcome-based pricing are future levers.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，赋予 Claude 更多自主性与自我认知能提升实用性；Token 效率与基于结果的定价是未来杠杆。

kolter.en: Machine learning is framed as hypothesis class, loss, optimization; evaluation requires proper data splits.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，机器学习被定义为假设类、损失函数和优化方法；评估需正确划分数据以避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; safety issue is specification-following.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是伪命题；安全核心是模型遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers; agent security introduces new vulnerabilities like prompt injection.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，安全需要显式训练和多层防御；智能体安全带来提示注入等新漏洞。

kolter.en: Automated red teaming outperforms humans; larger models are not inherently safer; agents need new security.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，自动化红队超越人类；更大模型并不天然更安全；智能体需新型安全方案。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just compute or scaling.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新和精选数据，而非单纯的算力或 Scaling。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for building trust in AI predictions, enabling practical use in science.
jumper.zh: 置信度指标对于建立对 AI 预测的信任至关重要，使其能在科学中实际应用。

jumper.en: AI tools like AlphaFold narrow hypothesis space, making experiments more efficient, not replacing scientists.
jumper.zh: 像 AlphaFold 这样的 AI 工具缩小了假设空间，提高了实验效率，而非取代科学家。

jumper.en: Specialized architectures and mid-size wins, not just scaling, drove AlphaFold 2's breakthrough.
jumper.zh: 专门的架构和多个中等规模的胜利，而非单纯的 Scaling，推动了 AlphaFold 2 的突破。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of experiments, not a full cell model; understanding remains with humans.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 是实验的狭义预测器，而非完整的细胞模型；理解仍由人类完成。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; alignment won't emerge from scaling alone. Safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的；对齐不会仅靠规模扩张自然涌现。安全研究需要前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent (3% understood); AGI is a smooth curve, not a point. Post-training gains importance.
dario.zh: 可解释性尚处萌芽（仅理解约 3%）；AGI 是平滑曲线而非单点。后训练重要性上升。

dario.en: AI progress is exponential; risks shift to misuse and overheating. Open source is a red herring; quality matters.
dario.zh: AI 进展呈指数级；风险转向滥用和过热。开源是伪命题；质量才是关键。

dario.en: We're near the end of the exponential; a 'country of geniuses' likely in 1-3 years. Economic disruption is real.
dario.zh: 我们接近指数增长的尾声；'天才之国'可能在 1-3 年内到来。经济冲击是真实的。

dario.en: Safety and capabilities are intertwined; interpretability and alignment are key. Enterprise focus aligns with safety.
dario.zh: 安全与能力相辅相成；可解释性和对齐是关键。企业级专注与安全价值观一致。

ivyross.en: Design should address unarticulated needs; intuition complements data in decisions.
ivyross.zh: 设计应满足未言明的需求；直觉与数据互补，共同指导决策。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; technology should amplify humanity, not replace it.
ivyross.zh: 自然是更好的设计师；技术应增强人性，而非取代人性。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders must foster conditions for play and intuition.
ivyross.zh: 约束激发创造力；领导者需营造利于玩耍和直觉发挥的条件。

fiona.en: Leadership in AI era: use one-on-ones for live talks, dogfood product, listen first, align mission and speed.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初，强调 AI 时代的领导力：一对一用于实时对话而非状态更新，亲自使用产品（dogfooding）以建立同理心，接收反馈时先倾听而非辩解，并注重使命对齐与速度。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth no longer bottleneck; verification, review, coordination are. Planning becomes just-in-time, code is source of truth.
fiona.zh: 2026 年 5 月，指出工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、审查和跨职能协调成为新瓶颈；规划转向即时（JIT），代码成为唯一事实来源，文档需与代码同步。

fiona.en: AI lifts ceiling for all; high agency with accountability key. Verification frameworks crucial as code velocity increases.
fiona.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为 AI 提升了所有人的能力上限，强调高自主性与高责任感；随着代码速度提升，验证和质量框架变得更重要。

fiona.en: Engineers may feel lonely with agents; pair lunches help. Joy shifts from coding flow to product impact.
fiona.zh: 2026 年 6 月，提出工程师与智能体协作可能感到孤独，可通过配对午餐缓解；满足感从编码心流转向产品影响。

fiona.en: Role boundaries blur: non-engineers ship code. Metrics like LOC mislead; focus on outcomes. Apprenticeship for next-gen engineers.
fiona.zh: 2026 年 6 月，指出角色边界模糊，非工程师也能交付代码；行数等指标会误导，应关注结果；下一代工程师需学徒制培养。

ethanhe.en: Visual intelligence gains come from language models, not video models; future UIs will be generative pixels from intent.
ethanhe.zh: 视觉智能的提升主要来自语言模型而非视频模型；未来界面将直接从意图生成像素。

ethanhe.en: World models need real-time interactive long-horizon video generation; robotics may be solved via virtual simulation without real-world interaction.
ethanhe.zh: 世界模型需要实时、交互、长时程的视频生成；机器人技术或许能通过虚拟仿真解决，无需真实世界交互。

ethanhe.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; experience and expertise are crucial for effective use, juniors often misuse it.
ethanhe.zh: AI 是通用技术；经验和专业知识对有效使用至关重要，初级人员常误用。

ethanhe.en: Human taste and genuine points of view become more valuable as AI commoditizes quality; developing your own voice is key.
ethanhe.zh: 随着 AI 将质量商品化，人类的品味和独特观点变得更有价值；培养自己的声音是关键。

ethanhe.en: Biggest risk is losing human talent pipeline due to over-reliance on AI; policy may protect some professions even if AI is better.
ethanhe.zh: 最大风险是因过度依赖 AI 而失去人才管道；政策可能保护某些职业，即使 AI 更优。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually; self-driving cars will dominate as insurance makes human driving costly.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入；自动驾驶将因保险成本而主导，人类驾驶将变得昂贵。

fadell.en: Taking breaks and boredom spark breakthrough ideas; self-care and mentorship are key after success.
fadell.zh: 休息和无聊激发突破性想法；成功后的自我关怀和指导他人至关重要。

fadell.en: Start with a press release to define story; small teams thrive on self-management; climate tech is underinvested.
fadell.zh: 从新闻稿开始定义故事；小团队靠自我管理；气候技术投资不足。

fadell.en: Great products are painkillers, not vitamins; v1 decisions are opinion-based; experts can hinder innovation.
fadell.zh: 好产品是止痛药而非维生素；初版决策基于观点；专家可能阻碍创新。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; future devices complement smartphones; smart home still 5-6 years away.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器上下文；未来设备补充智能手机；智能家居仍需 5-6 年。

fadell.en: Start from customer pain; products need three generations; humans must stay in loop to avoid technical debt.
fadell.zh: 从客户痛点出发；产品需三代迭代；人类需参与以避免技术债。

fadell.en: Existential threats drive change; AI wearables will be federated, not a single device; displays remain necessary.
fadell.zh: 生存威胁驱动变革；AI 可穿戴设备将是联邦式而非单一设备；显示屏仍必要。

lecun.en: Intelligence is learned, not hardwired; self-supervised learning builds world models like babies observe.
lecun.zh: 智能是习得的而非硬编码；自监督学习通过观察构建世界模型，如同婴儿学习。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; text alone insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot reach human-level intelligence; JEPA and open source are key.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 无法达到人类级智能；JEPA 和开源是关键。

lecun.en: LLMs lack world models, less intelligent than a cat; next AI needs non-generative architectures.
lecun.zh: LLM 缺乏世界模型，智能不如猫；下一代 AI 需要非生成式架构。

lecun.en: World models enable planning; LLMs are a dead end; open research and robotics next.
lecun.zh: 世界模型实现规划；LLM 是死胡同；开放研究与机器人是下一步。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable due to compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but chose not to launch.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年，我认为 AI 进展因算力扩展而可预测；谷歌早在 2020 年就拥有 ChatGPT 级别的技术，但因保守而未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is infinitesimal; singularity is centuries away.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年，我预测 AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在性风险微乎其微；奇点还很遥远。

suleyman.en: AI systems lack consciousness; focus on containment and alignment; superintelligence requires humanist values.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年，我强调 AI 没有意识，应聚焦遏制与对齐；超级智能需以人为本。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence is near; Microsoft must build own frontier models; white-collar tasks automated, not jobs.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年，我认为超级智能临近；微软需自研前沿模型；白领任务将被自动化，而非整个岗位。

satya.en: AI's true value is enabling unique user outcomes, not benchmark scores; private evals are key IP.
satya.zh: AI 的真正价值在于实现用户独特的成果，而非基准分数；私有评估是关键知识产权。

satya.en: Shift from per-user to consumption pricing; agents maximize returns for generalists, not specialists.
satya.zh: 从按用户定价转向按消耗定价；智能体时代通才收益最大，而非专才。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 是企业的未来；每家企业必须构建自己的爬山机器，以复利积累代币资本。

satya.en: Biggest risk is tacit knowledge leaking via AI training; CEOs must understand token capital deeply.
satya.zh: 最大风险是隐性知识通过 AI 训练泄露；CEO 必须深刻理解代币资本。

satya.en: Sovereign AI via enabling companies to hill-climb, not firewalls; global GDP could compound at 10%.
satya.zh: 主权 AI 应通过赋能企业爬山实现，而非防火墙；全球 GDP 或可复利增长 10%。

murati.en: Scaling laws and iterative deployment with public feedback are key for alignment and safety.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她强调缩放定律与迭代部署，认为通过公众反馈能提升安全与对齐。

murati.en: AGI will transform every aspect of life, demanding responsible development and public safety work.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她指出 AGI 将改变生活方方面面，需负责任地开发，安全研究应公开进行。

murati.en: Shift from turn-based to time-based interaction models for real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她主张从轮次式转向基于时间的交互模型，实现实时高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Emphasize institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances over individual character in AI governance.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她强调 AI 治理中制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要。

murati.en: Keep humans in the loop as long as possible to ensure durable progress and align intent and values.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她认为应尽可能让人类参与其中，以确保持久进步并校准意图与价值观。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; AI DJ is a true generative product solving unknown listening needs.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他认为互联网正从策展走向推荐再到生成，AI DJ 是真正解决“不知听什么”的生成式产品。

gustav.en: Generative AI makes uniqueness harder, not easier; AI music is an instrument enabling new creators, not fake.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他反共识地指出生成式 AI 让独特更难而非更易，AI 音乐应被视为新乐器而非伪造。

gustav.en: Long tenure builds trust and efficiency; functional orgs work if leadership is stable, contrary to politics fears.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他强调长期任期带来信任与效率，职能组织在稳定领导下可避免政治化，反共识。

gustav.en: Strategy is 'time well spent' prioritizing well-being over engagement; allowing video-off is anti-engagement.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他将战略定为“时间花得值”，优先用户福祉而非参与度，允许关视频是反参与决策。

gustav.en: Generative AI gives users control via plain English; AI should empower, not addict, users.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他认为生成式 AI 让用户用自然语言掌控服务，AI 应赋权而非致瘾，这是反共识押注。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，他认为将非正式模型扩展到数学 AI 不可行，形式化验证对可靠证明至关重要。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，他提出自动形式化比证明更难，正确形式化无解命题极具挑战。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，他深化观点：形式化验证旨在扩展才华而非仅消除错误，能带来性能提升。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，他坚持认为仅靠非正式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能，必须结合形式化方法。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，他补充即使超级 AI 能证明定理，人类的品味与直觉仍不可或缺。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows smooth exponential growth; pre-training scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，AI 进展呈平滑指数增长；预训练的缩放定律仍然有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent model gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，后训练改进（如强化学习和合成数据）驱动了近期模型的大部分进步；经济压力使焦点从规模扩张转向更小的模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning, RL, and tools enable solving hard problems, but models still need vast data and have jagged generalization edges.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，推理、强化学习和工具能解决难题，但模型仍需海量数据，且泛化能力参差不齐。

kaiser.en: Coding agents boost researcher productivity 5-10x; hardware progress democratizes AI experimentation at single-GPU scale.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，编码智能体将研究者效率提升 5-10 倍；硬件进步使单 GPU 规模的 AI 实验民主化。

kaiser.en: Near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing than existential risk; open source models persist for sovereignty reasons.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，系统入侵等近期风险比存在性风险更紧迫；开源模型因主权原因而持续存在。

felixrieseberg.en: AI's future lies in local computers and shared tools; scaffolding may fade as models improve.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月：AI 的未来在于本地计算机和共享工具；随着模型改进，脚手架可能不再重要。

felixrieseberg.en: AI should handle tedious tasks, but not personal preferences like booking flights; focus on execution.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月：AI 应处理繁琐任务，而非个人偏好如订机票；重在执行。

felixrieseberg.en: The main gap is people's mindset; almost any problem can be given to AI, especially for kids.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月：主要差距在于人的思维；几乎任何问题都可以交给 AI，尤其对孩子。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks, Opus for open-ended; asynchronous interaction is ideal.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月：用 Sonnet 处理明确任务，Opus 处理开放问题；异步交互最理想。

felixrieseberg.en: Debug workflows with Claude; don't supervise closely, judge by final impact.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月：用 Claude 调试工作流；不要密切监督，以最终效果评判。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla; data quality and efficiency matter as much as compute. Open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，缩放定律被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量与效率同算力同等重要；开源通过审查促进安全。

mensch.en: Data quality is a major bottleneck; algorithmic gains can yield 100x efficiency. Value shifts to applications, not just models.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，数据质量成为主要瓶颈；算法改进可带来百倍效率提升。价值从模型转向应用层。

mensch.en: AI must be embraced; sovereign AI requires control over data and infrastructure. Open source empowers enterprises and governments.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，AI 应被拥抱而非恐惧；主权 AI 要求掌控数据与基础设施。开源赋能企业与政府。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; differentiation via customization and vertical specialization. Pre-training saturates; fine-tuning and agents drive value.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，模型商品化；差异化靠定制与垂直专业化。预训练饱和，微调与智能体驱动价值。

mensch.en: Europe needs strategic autonomy in AI; deep enterprise engagement and human-in-the-loop agents are key. AGI is a direction, not a destination.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，欧洲需 AI 战略自主；深度企业参与和人在回路的智能体是关键。AGI 是方向而非终点。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics shift focus from compute to memory bandwidth; batch size and sparsity are key levers.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 4 月，推理经济学从算力转向内存带宽；批大小和稀疏性是关键杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost, challenging scaling laws.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 4 月，由于推理成本，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优，挑战缩放定律。

reinerpope.en: Chip design reveals data movement dominates compute; low precision yields superlinear gains.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月，芯片设计表明数据移动主导算力；低精度带来超线性收益。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are many tiny TPUs tiled; systolic arrays and scratchpad are core for AI chips.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月，GPU 是许多小型 TPU 的拼接；脉动阵列和便签存储器是 AI 芯片核心。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的不变核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减；进一步进展需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，可以提升推理能力并突破预训练限制。

oriol.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL are still a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math.
oriol.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是蓝海，在编码和数学之外有巨大潜力。

jonyive.en: Design driven by values and purpose, not profit; simplicity as essence, not minimalism; virtual communication cannot replace in-person presence.
jonyive.zh: 设计应受价值观和目的驱动，而非利润；简洁是本质而非极简；虚拟交流无法替代面对面相处。

jonyive.en: Simplicity requires joy and humanity; speed and quality compatible; making for each other more powerful than making for demand.
jonyive.zh: 简洁需要愉悦和人性；速度与质量可兼得；为彼此而做比迎合需求更有力量。

jonyive.en: Innovation is essential to design; tradition is preserving fire, not worshiping ashes; authenticity in user experience is paramount.
jonyive.zh: 创新是设计的本质；传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬；用户体验的真实性至关重要。

jonyive.en: Electric powertrains enable new design possibilities; performance is multidimensional, lateral dynamics over longitudinal speed.
jonyive.zh: 电动动力系统带来新的设计可能；性能是多维的，横向动态优于纵向速度。

jonyive.en: Collaboration with outsiders can achieve true disruption; each model must maintain unique identity, avoiding déjà vu.
jonyive.zh: 与外部合作可实现真正的颠覆；每款车型应保持独特身份，避免似曾相识。

jennywen.en: Traditional design process is outdated; trust intuition and craft over rigid steps.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年，认为传统设计流程已过时，应信任直觉与手艺而非僵化步骤。

jennywen.en: Design process is dead; designers must build fast, ship early, and adapt to AI.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 3 月，宣称设计流程已死，设计师需快速构建、尽早发布并适应 AI。

jennywen.en: Designers should be block-shaped generalists; speed and judgment beat taste alone.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 5 月，主张设计师应成为块状通才，速度与判断力胜过单纯品味。

lambert.en: RLHF remains dominant; openness prevents corporate capture; safety is system-level; audio lowers barriers.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，RLHF 仍是主流微调技术；开放至关重要以防企业垄断；安全是系统级属性；音频接口降低使用门槛。

lambert.en: Post-training data quality beats algorithms; SFT gives 90% performance; RL with verifiable rewards boosts reasoning.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，后训练中数据质量优于算法；SFT 贡献九成性能；基于可验证奖励的强化学习提升推理能力。

lambert.en: RLVR is key but overoptimization risks; hybrid reasoning models may be temporary; open models need tool-use training.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，RLVR 是关键但存在过度优化风险；混合推理模型或为过渡；开放模型需加强工具使用训练。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling persists but low-hanging fruit gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling; Chinese open models fill vacuum.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，预训练缩放定律仍有效但易得收益已尽；重心转向后训练与推理缩放；中国开源模型填补空白。

lambert.en: Open models drive research for a decade; US-China gap widens due to compute; distillation gray area; open models may be unsustainable.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，开放模型驱动未来十年研究；算力限制拉大中美差距；蒸馏处于灰色地带；开放模型长期或难持续。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is key; curiosity-driven exploration without goals improves it.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，强调超越训练分布的泛化是关键，无目标的、好奇心驱动的探索能提升泛化能力。

pathak.en: Reinforcement learning relies on dense rewards, unrealistic in real tasks; goal-free exploration correlates with higher intelligence.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，指出强化学习依赖密集奖励，在真实任务中不现实；无目标探索与更高智力相关。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem; no internet of robot data, so use all sources: videos, simulation, real-world.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，认为机器人学是数据问题，没有机器人数据的互联网，因此要利用所有数据源：视频、仿真、真实世界。

pathak.en: A general-purpose brain, like ChatGPT for language, can power any robot across form factors and tasks.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，提出像 ChatGPT 之于语言一样的通用大脑，可以驱动任何形态和任务的机器人。

pathak.en: Deployment is the primary challenge in robotics; it requires rigorous testing and cannot be scaled like software.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，强调部署是机器人学的主要挑战，需要严格测试，不能像软件那样规模化。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities like in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是通用可微计算机；通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling（规模扩张）会产生涌现能力，如上下文内学习。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is key but must maintain entropy; Tesla's end-to-end approach is right; humanoid robots benefit from car transfer learning.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是关键但需保持熵；特斯拉端到端路线正确；人形机器人受益于汽车迁移学习。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: LLMs as operating systems, prompts as programs; decade of agents, not year; vibe coding democratizes development.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：LLM 如同操作系统，提示词即程序；这是智能体的十年而非一年；vibe coding 使开发民主化。

karpathy.en: Pre-training is crappy evolution; RL is terrible; synthetic data collapses; cognitive core may be tiny, stripped of memory.
karpathy.zh: 预训练如同糟糕的进化；强化学习效果差；合成数据导致模型崩溃；认知核心可能很小，剥离记忆。

karpathy.en: I haven't typed code since December; agents are primary; jagged intelligence persists; agent-first tools and open-source lag are healthy.
karpathy.zh: 自去年十二月起我不再写代码；智能体成为主力；智能的锯齿状持续存在；智能体优先的工具和开源滞后是健康的。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；扩展推理模型将加速进展。

pachocki.en: AI alignment is pressing; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate real-world risks.
pachocki.zh: AI 对齐紧迫；迭代部署有助于学习并减轻现实风险。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is core, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心，通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现；思维链监控有助于对齐。

pachocki.en: Models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms; RL alone suffices for continual learning.
pachocki.zh: 模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式；仅强化学习即可实现持续学习。

pachocki.en: Biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations run by few.
pachocki.zh: 最大的社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织导致权力集中。

kendall.en: End-to-end learning is superior to hand-coded stacks, and is now interpretable with modern tools.
kendall.zh: 端到端学习优于手工编码的堆栈，并且借助现代工具已具备可解释性（2025）。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, such as nudging forward on blind turns.
kendall.zh: 世界模型支持推理和涌现的安全行为，例如在盲弯处缓慢前探（2025）。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, human interaction, and introspection in driving models.
kendall.zh: 语言集成改善了驾驶模型的表征、人机交互和内省能力（2025→26）。

kendall.en: Scaling a generalizable AI driver requires massive data, compute, and world models for simulation.
kendall.zh: 扩展通用型 AI 驾驶员需要海量数据、算力和用于仿真的世界模型（2026）。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality are more critical than algorithmic innovation for deep learning.
kendall.zh: 对于深度学习，基础设施和数据质量比算法创新更为关键（2026）。

carlpei.en: Brand building is core, not an afterthought; survival is key for startups.
carlpei.zh: 品牌建设是核心而非事后考虑；生存是初创公司的关键。

carlpei.en: Smartphone future lies in AI agents and generative UI, not hardware changes.
carlpei.zh: 智能手机的未来在于 AI 智能体和生成式 UI，而非硬件变革。

carlpei.en: AI models commoditized; focus on applied AI for consumers, not hype.
carlpei.zh: AI 模型商品化；专注于面向消费者的应用型 AI，而非炒作。

carlpei.en: Design is key differentiator in mature categories; AI is an ingredient.
carlpei.zh: 在成熟品类中，设计是关键差异化因素；AI 是配料。

carlpei.en: Smartphones won't be replaced by glasses; only brain-computer interfaces could.
carlpei.zh: 智能手机不会被眼镜取代；只有脑机接口可能取代。

turley.en: The model is the product; iterate like software, ship daily, and learn from real-world feedback.
turley.zh: 模型即产品；要像软件一样迭代，每日发布，从真实反馈中学习。

turley.en: Chat is not the future interface; it's like MS-DOS, and we haven't built Windows yet.
turley.zh: 聊天不是未来界面；它就像 MS-DOS，我们还没造出 Windows。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous for frontier models, accelerated for products.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分离；前沿模型要严格，产品开发要加速。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth from friction removal, core investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星指标是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、核心投资和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models are transformative.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要主动、富交互的产品，超越聊天机器人；推理模型具有变革性。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, requiring new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AGI 至少还需十年以上；仅靠大语言模型可能无法实现 AGI，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading and gameable; real progress needs deep human evaluations with sophisticated evaluators.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年，我指出 Elo 等基准具有误导性且易被操纵；真正的进步需要通过复杂的人类评估来衡量。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks for models to learn from.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我认为强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实任务让模型学习。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge in objective functions, leading to differentiated AIs; eventually every company should train its own models.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，前沿实验室的目标函数不同，导致 AI 差异化；最终每家公司都应训练自己的模型以符合自身理念。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI can hallucinate; human judgment is critical, and safety must prioritize over accuracy, including avoiding omission.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年，在医学领域，AI 可能产生幻觉，人类判断至关重要；安全应优先于准确性，包括避免遗漏。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems with scale, not narrow applications, to maximize impact.
kohli.zh: AI 在科学中应针对根节点问题并借助规模，而非狭窄应用，以最大化影响（2024→26）。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 当与真值检测器结合时，LLM 的幻觉可用于创造性发现（2024→26）。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 如今，结合强化学习的后训练是推动超越人类知识的关键（2026）。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 大型语言模型是通往智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据（2026）。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains like code and games are crucial for AI to surpass human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 像代码和游戏这样可验证的领域，对 AI 超越人类知识至关重要（始终）。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI knowledge and reducing hallucinations; LLMs are like operating systems.
jimfan.zh: 具身对 AI 知识落地和减少幻觉至关重要；LLM 如同操作系统。

jimfan.en: Simulation is key for training embodied agents, enabling massive parallelization and safe exploration.
jimfan.zh: 模拟是训练具身智能体的关键，可实现大规模并行和安全探索。

jimfan.en: Data is the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future.
jimfan.zh: 数据是机器人学的主要瓶颈；来自模拟和世界模型的合成数据是未来。

jimfan.en: A simple end-to-end model leveraging diverse data sources is key to building robot foundation models.
jimfan.zh: 利用多样数据源的简单端到端模型是构建机器人基础模型的关键。

jimfan.en: The physical Turing test—a robot cleaning a messy house—is the grand challenge for embodied AI.
jimfan.zh: 物理图灵测试——机器人打扫凌乱的房子——是具身 AI 的重大挑战。

nando.en: AI should augment human capabilities broadly; video learning and generalist agents like Gato are promising paths toward AGI.
nando.zh: AI 应广泛增强人类能力；视频学习与 Gato 等通才智能体是通往 AGI 的有希望路径。

nando.en: From emphasizing AI as a tool for all humanity to stressing AI safety and responsible deployment as the biggest challenges.
nando.zh: 从强调 AI 作为全人类的工具，转向强调 AI 安全与负责任部署是最大挑战。

nando.en: Africa leapfrogs legacy issues in AI; local language models can revolutionize education; human skills matter as much as coding.
nando.zh: 非洲在 AI 上跨越式发展；本地语言模型可革新教育；人际技能与编程同等重要。

nando.en: Consistently values diversity, inclusion, and learning from diverse data sources (YouTube, local languages) for better AI.
nando.zh: 始终重视多样性与包容性，以及从多样数据源（如 YouTube、本地语言）学习以构建更好的 AI。

nando.en: AI safety is an open problem; no solutions yet; informal collaboration between labs is key to progress.
nando.zh: AI 安全仍是开放问题，尚无解决方案；实验室间的非正式合作是进步关键。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, dramatically boosting intelligence.
sholto.zh: 2024 年：长上下文被低估；上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能大幅提升智能。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning is a new scaling axis; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI without new breakthroughs.
sholto.zh: 2025 年：强化学习成为新的扩展轴；预训练加 RL 可能足以实现 AGI，无需新突破。

sholto.en: Agent reliability, not capability, is the bottleneck; coding is the leading indicator for AI progress.
sholto.zh: 2025 年：智能体的瓶颈是可靠性而非能力；编程是 AI 进展的领先指标。

sholto.en: Progress is exponential; longer agentic coherence (e.g., 30 hours) expands achievable tasks dramatically.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：进展是指数级的；更长的智能体连贯性（如 30 小时）大幅扩展可完成任务。

sholto.en: Capability overhang dominates; managing agent teams and compute supply matter more than raw intelligence.
sholto.zh: 2026 年：能力过剩主导；管理智能体团队和算力供应比原始智能更重要。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better algorithms and data can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必能解决常识问题；拥有更好算法和数据的较小模型可以超越较大模型。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; all AI methods reduce to data, and current methods interpolate human knowledge.
yejin.zh: 从 2023 年到 2025 年，我越来越强调数据是根本瓶颈，所有 AI 方法都归结为数据，现有方法只是内插人类知识。
