yejin.en: Reinforcement learning requires careful engineering; RLVR can decrease pass@k even as best-of-n improves.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我认为强化学习需要精细工程；RLVR 可能降低 pass@k，即使 best-of-n 有所提升。

yejin.en: Small language models can be powerful with diverse synthetic data; pluralistic alignment respects diverse human values.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我主张通过多样化的合成数据使小语言模型强大，并采用多元对齐以尊重不同人类价值观。

yejin.en: Open research is crucial for democratizing AI; AI safety requires addressing value pluralism.
yejin.zh: 始终，我坚持开放研究对 AI 民主化至关重要，AI 安全需处理价值多元性。

truell.en: Scaling laws predict AI progress; test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling.
truell.zh: 2024 年，我认为缩放定律可预测 AI 进步，且测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练缩放成为主要驱动力。

truell.en: Natural language won't be primary programming method; examples and direct manipulation better.
truell.zh: 2024 年，我反共识地认为自然语言不会是主要编程方式，示例和直接操作更优。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to intent specification; taste and logic design valued.
truell.zh: 2025 年，我强调编程从代码转向意图说明，品味和逻辑设计比细心更重要。

truell.en: Custom models crucial for product quality; every magic moment involves custom model.
truell.zh: 2025 年，我指出定制模型对产品质量至关重要，Cursor 的每个神奇时刻都依赖定制模型。

truell.en: AI shift more consequential than internet; will take decades to unfold.
truell.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 变革比互联网影响更大，且需数十年展开。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，主张设计师应会编程以建立同理心并加速交付；优先追求速度与熟悉感，而非完美。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy for startups should focus on recruiting and differentiation; brand guidelines are dynamic platforms.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，认为初创品牌策略应聚焦招聘与差异化；品牌指南应是动态平台，而非僵化规则。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate its role in winning, and brand narrative attracts talent.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，强调设计是战略武器，创始人需阐明其制胜作用；品牌叙事成为吸引人才的关键。

henrymodisett.en: Hire diverse archetypes, not clones; avoid structured crits; adapt process to problem; gut beats data in fast startups.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，主张招聘多元原型而非克隆；避免结构化评审；流程因问题而异；快公司中直觉胜于数据。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs, empowering designers, and shipping fast remain consistent priorities across both periods.
henrymodisett.zh: 始终，追求极致速度、赋能设计师、快速迭代是贯穿两个时期的一致主线。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应成为赋能者而非瓶颈，通过引导工程师并统一问题认知来发挥作用。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt: it fluctuates, and you pay it off iteratively alongside technical debt.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务：它会波动，你需要与技术债务一起迭代偿还。

nadchishtie.en: Maximize learning through rapid, scrappy experimentation and short iteration cycles.
nadchishtie.zh: 通过快速、粗糙的实验和短迭代周期最大化学习。

nadchishtie.en: Treat AI as a creative partner; jam with it openly without rigid structure.
nadchishtie.zh: 将 AI 视为创意伙伴，开放地与其即兴合作，无需僵化结构。

nadchishtie.en: The future of design tools is interoperable, with code as the source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计工具的未来是互操作的，代码成为唯一事实来源。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable.
nadchishtie.zh: 拥有端到端执行能力并利用 AI 填补空白的通才最有价值。

nadchishtie.en: Portfolios should prioritize craft and intentionality over process documentation.
nadchishtie.zh: 作品集应优先展示工艺和意图，而非过程文档。

nadchishtie.en: Hiring managers look for high-slope individuals with intrinsic drive and learning aptitude.
nadchishtie.zh: 招聘经理寻找具有内在驱动力和学习能力的高斜率人才。

nadchishtie.en: Side projects can outweigh traditional experience if they demonstrate care and skill.
nadchishtie.zh: 如果副项目展现出用心和技能，它们可能比传统经验更重要。

nadchishtie.en: Paid test work provides more signal than any other interview stage.
nadchishtie.zh: 付费测试工作比任何其他面试阶段提供更多信号。

leike.en: AI safety is crucial; empirical research is under-explored. Focus on skill building, not capability research.
leike.zh: 2018 年：AI 安全至关重要，实证研究尚待开发。应注重技能培养，而非能力研究。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight and interpretability. Alignment may be easier than thought.
leike.zh: 2023 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，需要可扩展监督和可解释性。对齐可能比想象中容易。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training insufficient. Third-party oversight and regulation necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年：OpenAI 安全文化退化，后训练不足；需要第三方监督和监管。

shazeer.en: Initially, LLMs are alchemy; scaling with compute and data yields intelligence, but inner workings remain mysterious.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为大语言模型如同炼金术，通过算力和数据扩展能带来智能，但内部机制仍是个谜。

shazeer.en: By 2025, he emphasizes algorithmic advances and inference-time compute scaling as key to further progress.
shazeer.zh: 到 2025 年，他转而强调算法进步和推理时算力扩展是进一步突破的关键。

shazeer.en: He shifts from passive data learning to advocating models that act in the world, using reinforcement learning.
shazeer.zh: 他从被动数据学习转向主张模型在世界中行动，并利用强化学习。

shazeer.en: He now sees agentic capabilities and long context windows as crucial for AGI, not just scaling.
shazeer.zh: 他现在认为智能体能力和长上下文窗口对 AGI 至关重要，而不仅仅是规模扩展。

shazeer.en: Consistently, he believes AI's best applications are unforeseen, and safety requires human oversight.
shazeer.zh: 他始终认为 AI 的最佳应用是难以预见的，且安全需要人类监督。

abbeel.en: Believed RL with simulation could enable robots to beat Federer, but stressed need for hardware and software advances.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，他认为借助强化学习和仿真，机器人有望击败费德勒，但强调硬件和软件都需重大进步。

abbeel.en: Shifted focus to combining unsupervised learning with RL for sample efficiency, and using prior knowledge for data generation, not hard-coding.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他转向结合无监督学习与强化学习以提升样本效率，并主张用先验知识生成数据而非硬编码。

abbeel.en: Emphasized 99.9% reliability as benchmark for real-world robotics value, and single neural network generalization across tasks.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他强调 99.9%的可靠性是现实机器人创造价值的基准，并认为单一神经网络可跨任务泛化。

abbeel.en: Noted pre-trained language models internalize reasoning patterns transferable to non-language tasks, a continuity from 2018's fine-tuning insight.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他指出预训练语言模型内化的推理模式可迁移到非语言任务，延续了 2018 年关于微调的见解。

abbeel.en: Consistently valued self-play and imitation learning for robot skill acquisition, and opposed hard-coding prior knowledge.
abbeel.zh: 始终重视自博弈和模仿学习在机器人技能获取中的作用，并反对硬编码先验知识。
